Boats equipped with top-of-the-line fishing gear and electronics

blurb: Fish Maui offers private and shared fishing charters ranging from 4 to 10 hours. Guests fish for big game fish like marlin, tuna, wahoo, and mahi-mahi, or smaller reef fish on bottom fishing trips. The company provides experienced captains and crews, with options for beginners and various boat sizes and amenities.
extraNote: 24-72 hour cancellation policy · No pro-rated refunds for shortened trips · Tipping customary 15-20% of charter price · Shared charters require minimum 4 passengers to confirm · Shared charters may be canceled if minimum not met or bumped by private charter
